ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white macro-blobs occupy the central regions of both lobes. High-density black mottling and stippling are concentrated at the junction of the lobes and permeate the white regions. Solid black margins define the trailing edge and the perimeter of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 28 degrees and a narrow vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous linear boundary; specific large-amplitude indentations observed on the medial aspect of the right lobe and the distal aspect of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge transitioning into sharp, slightly cranially-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle attachment) localized on the outer distal tips of both lobes and along the upper trailing edge margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions observed within the white pigmented regions of both lobes, indicating shallow surface scoring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe proximal to the median notch; extensive barnacle colonization on distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'salt-and-pepper' stippling density across the transition zones between the primary black and white pigmentation regions.
